evidence.text: Stanley Kubrick -LRB- -LSB- ˈkuːbrɪk -RSB- July 26 , 1928 -- March 7 , 1999 -RRB- was an American film director , screenwriter , producer , cinematographer , editor , and photographer .
The Stanley Kubrick Archive is held by the University of the Arts London in their Archives and Special Collection Centre at the London College of Communication .
The Archive opened in October 2007 and contains material collected and owned by the film director Stanley Kubrick -LRB- 1928 -- 1999 -RRB- .
Items from the archive are on loan for the touring Stanley Kubrick Exhibition .
